user.title: 360 Robot Vacuum
user.description: Enter the qid and sid from your 360 account. Extract them once from the 360 Smart Home app via packet capture (look for requests to q.smart.360.cn).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate 360 Vacuum
reauth_confirm.description: The session for qid {qid} has expired. Capture a fresh sid from the 360 app and enter it below.

error.invalid_qid: The qid must be a numeric account ID (6-20 digits).
error.invalid_sid: The sid must be a 32-character hexadecimal string.
error.invalid_auth: The qid/sid were rejected by the 360 cloud. Re-capture them from the app.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the 360 cloud. Check your network and try again.
error.no_devices: No vacuums were found on this account.
